title: Carbon and its Compounds
seo_title: Carbon and its Compounds Class 10 Science Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 4)
standard_code: Class 10, Chapter 4: Carbon and its Compounds
standard_text: Carbon compounds: covalent bonding in carbon compounds, versatile nature of carbon, homologous series, nomenclature of carbon compounds containing functional groups (halogens, alcohol, ketones, aldehydes, alkanes and alkynes), saturated and unsaturated hydrocarbons, chemical properties of carbon compounds (combustion, oxidation, addition and substitution reaction), ethanol and ethanoic acid (only properties and uses), soaps and detergents.
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 10 Science worksheets for NCERT Chapter 4: covalent bonds, homologous series, naming alkanes, alkenes and alkynes, functional groups, ethanol, ethanoic acid, soaps and detergents. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Alkanes CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, alkenes CₙH₂ₙ, alkynes CₙH₂ₙ₋₂.
key_sub: Successive members differ by CH₂ (14 u).
body_html:
How to think about it

Carbon shares electrons to form covalent bonds. Its valency of four and catenation give a huge number of compounds. Hydrocarbons with only single bonds are saturated (alkanes); those with double or triple bonds are unsaturated (alkenes, alkynes).

Name compounds by the number of carbons (meth-, eth-, prop-, but-, pent-…) and the functional group: -ol (alcohol), -al (aldehyde), -one (ketone), -oic acid (carboxylic acid), chloro- (halogen). Members of a homologous series have the same functional group and differ by CH₂.

Example

Formula of propene?

3 carbons

alkene: CₙH₂ₙ

Answer: C₃H₆

Example

Covalent bonds in propane?

8 C–H + 2 C–C

Answer: 10

Common mistakes

  • Writing CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ for an alkene.
  • Forgetting the C–C bonds when counting bonds.
  • Thinking soaps work well in hard water.

faq.a: A family of carbon compounds with the same functional group and similar chemical properties, where each member differs by a CH₂ unit.
Soap molecules form micelles: the hydrocarbon tails dissolve in the oily dirt and the ionic heads face the water, so the dirt is washed away.
